text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Mom sent me some new sweets recently, and 
I've been eating them without restraint...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Hey, Laurel. Can you play tennis?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That's kind of sudden, isn't it? I can 
manage a quick rally, though.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good! In that case, come with me 
for a bit!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Hmph...! Is this meant for dieting?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Well, there's that too, but I just 
simply felt like playing it again after so 
long.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Didn't you have plenty of other ways you 
could've done it?"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I had a feeling that with you, we could 
have a really fun rally!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. Then I'll give it my all, so make 
sure you have tons and tons of fun, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow kept playing weekend 
tennis with Sakura Laurel, successfully 
shedding the extra weight.
